tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Search the talent graph. Returns ANONYMOUS match cards — headline, skills (with skills_matched showing which of YOUR terms hit), seniority, location, availability, salary range, and a short snippet — but NO name, full resume, or contact. Call get_candidate (a metered reveal) for the deeper anonymous

tools.name: get_candidate
tools.description: Evaluate one candidate in depth — full skills, summary, seniority, experience (titles + what they did) and education. Stays ANONYMOUS: no name, no contact, and employer names, dates, and graduation years are withheld to protect identity. Counts toward your hourly/daily reveal limit. To actually reac

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Reach out to one candidate. You identify yourself (your name + company, from your account); the candidate is notified and decides. If they accept, you receive an EMAIL with their contact, their message, and a unique verification code — their identity stays private until they choose to share it. METE

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Check the status of a contact request you sent: sent (awaiting), accepted (the candidate shared their contact — see shared_contact, and expect their intro email quoting the code), or declined. Identify it by contact_id or code. Also shows any hire outcome either side reported.

tools.name: report_contact_outcome
tools.description: One-tap outcome report on an accepted contact: did it lead to a hire? Optional but appreciated — it's how the marketplace measures that consented outreach beats cold outreach. Values: hired | not_hired | in_progress.

tools.name: get_new_candidates
tools.description: Get resumes new or updated since a timestamp (your standing alert). Same filters as search_candidates. Call daily with yesterday's timestamp; no duplicates.

tools.name: save_candidate
tools.description: Save a candidate resume to your watchlist with optional notes.

tools.name: get_corpus_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate stats about the talent corpus (counts, top skills/locations).

tools.name: check_subscription
tools.description: Check your subscription tier, status, rate limit, and usage this hour.

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Get the full QueryQuarry reference (how it works, all tools and filters, search tips, rate limits, privacy). Call this when you need detail beyond these tool descriptions, when guiding a new user, or before composing a complex search.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_contact" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_contact, get_contact · Private data: search_candidates, get_candidate, request_contact, get_contact, report_contact_outcome · Public sink: request_contact, get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_contact, get_contact · Private data: search_candidates, get_candidate, request_contact, get_contact, report_contact_outcome · Public sink: request_contact, get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
